title: The Effect of Information on Physical Fitness Measures and Training in Overweight Children
brief_summary: In the present study the investigators will examine the impact of varying information (positive compared to standard information) concerning a drink for improving physical fitness in overweight children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pre pubertal children
* Study group: BMI precentiles over 85 (overweight and obese children)
* Control group: BMI precentiles between 5-85 (normal weight children)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children with organic Disease
* Competitive athlete
